name: create_csharp_csv_category_totals
description: Builds a CSV category-totals aggregator (with row cleaning) consumed by an existing report printer
prompts: An existing ReportPrinter.cs calls SalesAggregator.CategoryTotals(csv), but the SalesAggregator class does not exist yet. Create SalesAggregator.cs defining `public static class SalesAggregator` with `public static List<(string Category, long Total)> CategoryTotals(string csv)`. It parses CSV text whose first line is the header `category,amount` and returns, for each category, its summed amount, as (Category, Total) tuples ordered by Category (ordinal ascending). Skip any data row whose category is empty/whitespace or whose amount is not a valid long integer. A category on multiple rows accumulates. Header-only or empty input returns an empty list. Do not modify ReportPrinter.cs.

setup_files.app.csproj:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- tests/ has its own project; without this the SDK's default glob
         compiles tests/*.cs into the app itself, where xunit isn't referenced -->
    <Compile Remove="tests/**" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>
